title: Facebook is paying people overseas promoting Alberta separatism
summary: This CBC investigative report reveals that Facebook/Meta has been paying overseas workers to amplify Alberta separatism content, raising concerns about foreign influence operations targeting Canadian political discourse. The company hired contractors in countries like the Philippines to boost engagement on posts about Western Canadian separatist movements.
problem_solved: Exposes foreign influence operations and social media manipulation targeting Canadian domestic politics and regional divisions.
why_valuable: This investigative journalism reveals how social media platforms can be weaponized to amplify divisive political content through overseas paid campaigns, threatening democratic processes.
